_comment: TOMI HUB access control. Edit this file to grant or revoke access - no need to touch loader.lua.
notice: TOMI HUB requires an access key.
notes: owners    : UserIds that skip the key check entirely. Put your own UserId here first.
whitelist : UserIds allowed in without a key.
keys      : key -> UserId. The key only works for that one account.
Use 0 as the UserId to make a key work for anyone.
getkey    : optional URL shown to users who need a key. Empty hides the button.
